name: Boulderfist Outpost
summary: Deep within Boulder'gor, Boulderfist ogres hold a fortified mound and its inner halls. A few Witherbark trolls dwell among them in the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: A Stronghold within the Mound
sections.body: Boulderfist Outpost lies at the heart of Boulder'gor in western Arathi. Brute enforcers rule the settlement above, while the clan's strength gathers inside the mound. Carved from earth and stone, its dark halls serve as a den and a holding place. A few Witherbark troll witch doctors live among the ogres, a sign that the tribes sometimes share this ground.

faq.answer: Boulderfist Outpost lies within Boulder'gor, the larger ogre settlement in the western Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why are there trolls inside an ogre outpost?
faq.answer: Witherbark forest trolls dwell nearby in the Arathi Highlands and sometimes share ground with the Boulderfist ogres. A few Witherbark witch doctors practice their craft inside the mound alongside them.

faq.q: Who is imprisoned in the outpost?
faq.answer: No named captives are known to be held in the outpost today. Boulderfist enforcers and a few Witherbark witch doctors occupy its damp corridors, where intruders should expect a fight rather than a rescue.

faq.q: Who leads the ogres inside the outpost?
faq.answer: Boulderfist brute enforcers patrol the interior. An exceptionally fierce ogre named Kovork lurks within the mound as a notable threat.

angles.text: Alliance scouts crossing Arathi should give the mound a wide berth. Boulderfist enforcers attack intruders on sight.
Boulderfist ogres make no distinction between factions. They attack Horde wanderers as readily as their Alliance rivals.
